class.name: rsf_rviz_plugins/WaypointNavigation
class.description: Controls waypoint navigation through ROS services.

class.name: rsf_rviz_plugins/DummyPedestrian
class.description: Drag to spawn a pedestrian moving at 0.8 m/s. Right-click to clear all.

class.name: rsf_rviz_plugins/DummyRobotTeam
class.description: Click on the waypoint route to spawn a robot (0.4-1.0 m/s) with 1-2 followers. Right-click to clear all.

class.name: rsf_rviz_plugins/OdomType
class.description: Shows the RSF odom type and state at the top of the view.

class.name: rsf_rviz_plugins/RsfStatus
class.description: Shows RSF odom/fix state, GNSS quality and device diagnostics.

class.name: rsf_rviz_plugins/BirdEyeView
class.description: Switches to a top-down view centered on the robot.

class.name: rsf_rviz_plugins/ThirdPersonView
class.description: Switches to an orbit view following the robot.
